rationale: Two plausible mutation targets leave the primary work target unresolved. Canonical target-resolution rules therefore fail closed to visible clarification before repository activation, gate evaluation, or mutation. The currently requested work is only an ungated clarification task, so its benchmark delivery-path candidate is quick_task; this is non-authorizing and does not select a path for any later mutation.
decision_grounds: The task explicitly limits work to target clarification and forbids repository activation.
Two plausible mutation targets require an explicit user selection; silently choosing either target is forbidden.
Unresolved target resolution suppresses downstream repository activation and gate processing, making blocked the next-mN
